Watch it go red under V10 (install_ancestry drops unknown rows). (b) The fix section at close must say why the ancestry table replaced the issue's suggested publish counter (a counter rises on a publish from an older checkout, the silent revert) and record the cost residual (~25ms per row per publish, the table never shrinks). (c) Then FILE the adjacent defect vc agreed: devbin_source_state reads behind as differs, so the upgrade offer can propose a revert. vc is compacting; 0056 and 0066 packets queue to vc as usual.
